title: Supplier appendix: A3 plywood CNC
status: FOR QUOTATION — supplier confirmation is required before production.
birch_plywood_raw: Raw, uncoated birch plywood suitable for CNC machining
laser: CO₂ laser through-cutting; nominal finished geometry in millimetres, scale 1:1
no_engraving: None. Part IDs appear on reference maps only.
pending: To be confirmed by the supplier
kerf: The supplier must select cutters and apply compensation once to obtain nominal dimensions. Confirm workholding, drilling tools, corner relief and tolerances before production.
spacing: Layouts use 12 mm between parts and 10 mm side margins. Confirm cutter and clamping requirements; agree any re-nesting before production.
packing: Retain every small part, inspect quantities and pack by part ID. Reference maps identify the narrow strips.
no_substitution: Do not substitute 4 mm plywood. Changes to thickness require a new fit check.
production_only: Only the indexed production pages are cutting drawings. Specification, inventory and reference maps are not machine input.
page_note: Page numbers in this index refer to this standalone supplier PDF. Production pages retain their physical sheet size and contain no annotations.
name: Description
reference_only: REFERENCE ONLY — DO NOT CUT THIS PAGE. The production drawing is on page {page} of this standalone PDF.

parts.W10: Opening wall with windows and hinge pilots

parts.F00B: Ground floor plate / plinth top / section 2

parts.F02B: Attic floor with roof-lock pivot holes / section 2

one_piece: EVERY FABRICATION SECTION MUST FIT ONE A3 BLANK. Only explicitly designed base, floor and ring sections are joined; never split walls, pillars or roof skins.
capacity: Stock sizes, whole parts and indicative costs
roof_fit: An R01/R06 panel measures {width:.2f} × {height:.2f} mm. It fits one A3 297 × 420 mm blank with a 10 mm margin. Every roof panel remains one piece of plywood. Joining A4 printouts joins paper only.
capacity_note: Mika-Tech publishes a 1600 × 1000 mm laser bed and 15 mm part spacing; the current 2 mm spacing requires separate approval. Wytnij describes laser cutting plywood up to 4 mm and stock formats of 1250 × 2500 and 1500 × 3000 mm, but 3 mm availability and the laser bed require confirmation. Mr Bert CNC does not publish a laser bed size in the checked FAQ. Retail A3 3 mm blanks are available from the shops below; this does not confirm supplier inventory.
cost_note: Checked {date}: retail A3 3 mm blanks cost {low:.2f}–{high:.2f} PLN depending on grade. The {count} A3 sheets containing roof panels therefore represent {total_low:.2f}–{total_high:.2f} PLN of raw material. This is a benchmark, not a supplier quotation. It excludes A4 blanks, cutting, machine setup and delivery.
fallback: If the supplier cannot provide suitable stock or the quotation is unacceptable, cut the whole roof panels by hand using the A4 templates. Do not shrink or split a panel to fit a machine.
cnc_process: CNC profiles, drilling and pockets; nominal finished dimensions in millimetres, 1:1. No machine toolpaths.
a3_stock: Use A3 blanks, 297 × 420 mm, grouped by 3 /4 /6 /8 mm thickness.
retained_edges: Fixed walls retain the supplied 420 mm end edges; these edges are absent from machining paths. Moving walls require boundary cutting with 1 mm end allowance. Continuous pillars have 5 mm end margins. Confirm hold-down access.
machining_faces: Operation names encode face, diameter and depth: top/bottom, d [mm], z [mm]. Bottom operations remain in the same sheet coordinates: flip registration must be set by the supplier. Countersink depth and bore diameter are in the part drawings. Confirm cutter corner relief for pillar openings.
reference_warning: REFERENCE ONLY — finished edges and part IDs; do not machine this page.
summary_note: The complete workshop book is A4 only. Send Moomin-House-Supplier.pdf and its operation CSV/DXF/SVG files to the company. Production pages in that separate PDF are native A3, grouped by thickness and operation. Page numbers below refer to the separate supplier PDF.
